jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager (422D1EC)
jobs.description:
Referment is working with a fast-growing, VC-backed B2B SaaS company to hire a Senior Customer Success Manager to take ownership of some of its most important customers across Europe and the US.

This is a commercially focused Customer Success role covering the full customer journey from onboarding and implementation through to adoption, retention and expansion.

You'll also be one of the early hires within the Customer Success function, giving you the opportunity to help shape the processes, playbooks and systems the team uses as the company scales.

The product sits within the sales and revenue technology ecosystem, so we're particularly interested in people who understand CRM, Salesforce and Revenue Operations.

The Role

You'll Be Responsible For

Owning a portfolio of important B2B customers.
Leading customers through onboarding and implementation.
Driving adoption and helping customers realise value quickly.
Owning retention, renewals and expansion across your accounts.
Identifying commercial growth opportunities within existing customers.
Building relationships with senior customer stakeholders.
Working with customers to understand their sales and revenue processes.
Supporting customers with CRM, data and workflow-related requirements.
Working with late-stage prospects where Customer Success or technical input is required.
Developing scalable Customer Success processes and playbooks.
Using customer data to identify risks and opportunities.
Working closely with Sales, Product and Marketing.
Bringing customer feedback into product and commercial decision-making.
Using AI and automation to improve Customer Success processes.
Helping build the wider Customer Success function as the business grows.

What We're Looking For

You'll ideally have:

Around 2–5+ years' relevant experience within Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering or a related role.
Experience working within a B2B SaaS environment.
Strong technical understanding of CRM systems and data integrations.
Good knowledge of Salesforce.
Experience working with Revenue Operations or Sales Operations teams.
Experience owning onboarding and customer implementations.
A track record of driving customer adoption and retention.
Commercial experience around renewals, expansion or account growth.
Strong data-driven decision-making skills.
Excellent executive communication and stakeholder-management skills.
Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Product and Marketing.
An interest in using AI and automation to improve customer processes

Experience as a Salesforce Administrator, RevOps professional or Solutions Engineer would be particularly interesting, especially if you've subsequently moved into a customer-facing commercial role.

Experience implementing complex SaaS products and knowledge of pipeline management, forecasting and CRM data would also be valuable.

This could suit a Senior Customer Success Manager, Customer Success Manager, Technical Customer Success Manager, Solutions Engineer or RevOps Manager looking for broader commercial ownership within a growing SaaS company.

jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.

Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

What You'll Be Doing

Integrate customers by assisting with license registration, entitlement activation, support access, and initial value planning.
Conduct needs assessments to align customer workloads with NVIDIA software libraries, frameworks, reference architectures, and platform capabilities.
Collaboratively define and track success metrics tied to business outcomes, workload performance, adoption health, and renewal readiness.
Promote adoption and growth across NVIDIA AI Enterprise, Run:ai, Mission Control, NIM, NeMo, NVIDIA Agent Toolkit, CUDA-X libraries, DGX OS, Omniverse/Physical AI, vGPU, and associated software.
Coordinate field teams, solution architects, support, product, engineering, partners, and customer collaborators to remove adoption blockers and accelerate time to value.
Lead customer health reviews and executive readouts that connect technical adoption to measurable customer outcomes.
Capture repeatable adoption patterns and customer feedback to improve enablement, support quality, and the overall customer experience.

What We Need To See

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
At least 8+ years working in customer success, technical account management, solution architecture, professional services, support leadership, or enterprise software deployment.
Customer-first approach with a genuine passion for helping customers achieve their goals and delivering outstanding experiences.
Technical curiosity and agility, with eagerness to learn emerging AI technologies and stay current in a rapidly evolving landscape.
Strong technical foundation across AI/ML concepts, accelerated computing workloads, cloud/on-prem infrastructure, and NVIDIA software.
Consultative engagement skills, with the ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value for diverse collaborators.
Experience managing complex customer relationships across technical users, business owners, executives, partners, and support teams.
Strategic perspective gained from experience in AI, accelerated computing, high-performance computing, cloud, or enterprise software settings.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Active listening and discovery skills that uncover the customer's platform, difficulties, operating model, and strategic objectives.
Ability to rapidly assimilate complex customer environments and map their challenges to practical NVIDIA platform recommendations.
Strength in simplifying complex technical architectures into clear, actionable mentorship for technical and non-technical audiences.
Visible passion for AI innovation and proficiency in accelerated computing, enterprise AI, and modern software adoption patterns.
Experience building customer lifecycle models, adoption dashboards, health scoring, or support-to-renewal playbooks.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Customer Value Manager -
Hybrid role based in Lexington, MA

About Mimecast

The work people build is worth protecting, and it's harder to protect than it used to be. AI agents now move at machine speed with human-level access, and a small slip-up can become a very public one. We disrupt cybercriminal activity before that happens. We think fast, go big, and always demand more of ourselves. We work hard, deliver, and repeat. We grow with real determination and put success well within reach. We push each other to be better and expect to be pushed back, in a community built on respect, where everyone is counted. Work Protected.

Overview

Are you passionate about stopping bad things from happening to good organizations? At Mimecast, we do just that—and in Customer Value Management, we go further by making sure every customer realizes real, measurable value from what they’ve invested in.

We are looking for a driven, customer-centric Customer Value Manager to support a portfolio of named mid-market accounts. Based locally to Lexington, Massachusetts, you’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor and work within a three-person account pod alongside an Account Manager and a Renewals Manager. Your focus is clear: drive product adoption and utilization, own technical and value health, and turn the capabilities of our platform into outcomes customers care about. The through-line of the role is simple: adoption drives outcomes, and outcomes create value.

What You'll Do

Own platform adoption, activation, utilization, configuration health, and optimization across Mimecast’s product portfolio, including Email Threat Protection, Human Risk Management, Incydr (Code42), and DMARC Analyzer.
Advance customers’ Human Risk Management maturity by connecting behavior and attack-exposure data to Mimecast’s HRM framework and recommending targeted awareness-training outcomes.
Own technical and value health across your portfolio, tracking adoption depth, feature utilization, deployment completeness, customer satisfaction signals, and renewal risk.
Quantify and communicate proof of value through adoption metrics, threat-block summaries, HRM progression, and deployment health; prepare technical briefings and lead the value and technical narrative in Business Reviews, on-site EBRs, and executive meetings.
Build trusted customer relationships across technical and executive stakeholders, understand each customer’s environment and definition of success, translate complex security architecture into business value, and represent the voice of the customer to Product Management.
Partner with Account and Renewals Managers to identify churn risk at least 90 days before renewal, lead technical recovery plans, document competitive threats, and support gross retention, net revenue retention, and expansion outcomes.
Identify expansion signals—including unused modules, seat growth, HRM maturity readiness, and compliance gaps—and provide the Account Manager with the technical context and timing rationale needed to act.
Own transparency around critical technical escalations by representing customer context internally, coordinating with Support Engineering, and keeping customers and pod partners informed through resolution.
Support the Executive Sponsor Program by identifying suitable accounts, facilitating introductions, coordinating sponsor cadence calls, and briefing Mimecast sponsors before engagements.
Use customer data, health signals, AI-guided insights, and next-best-action recommendations to prioritize work and deliver evidence-based value conversations at scale.

What You'll Bring

Demonstrated success managing a portfolio of mid-market or enterprise accounts with the autonomy and judgment expected of an experienced customer-facing professional, ideally within a security-focused SaaS organization.
Working knowledge of email security architecture, including Secure Email Gateways, Microsoft 365 Defender, DMARC, DKIM, SPF, email routing, and hybrid mail flow.

Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

Strategic Workforce Planning operates as an enterprise Center of Excellence with dedicated regional coverage. The Strategic Workforce Planning Analyst serves as the primary point of contact for workforce analytics, insights, and risk interpretation within an assigned region. This role uses common workforce planning frameworks, definitions, templates, and governance processes to support consistent, trusted, and actionable insights across the enterprise. The Strategic Workforce Planning Analyst will help co-author enterprise-level deliverables, including enterprise summaries, risk themes, and recommendations, in partnership with Strategic Initiatives Consultants and other HR partners using a common framework and materials.

Key Job Responsibilities

Serve as the workforce planning analytics and insights partner for an assigned region, interpreting local workforce trends, risks, and business context while collaborating across regions to support enterprise summaries, shared standards, and consistent workforce narratives.
Co-own workforce planning deliverables, including enterprise, Operating Company, and Business Unit summaries, key themes, commentary, and FAQs aligned to a common narrative structure.
Identify key workforce signals, connect them to business impact, and develop recommendations to support action, follow-through, and progress tracking.
Partner with Reporting & Analytics team to develop and refine workforce trends dashboards, including segmentation and “what changed” views.
Apply common workforce planning frameworks while incorporating local business context to support enterprise rollup, calibration, and alignment of risks, themes, and recommendations.
Reconcile differences across HR baseline data, staffing plans, and approved budget projections, documenting drivers, assumptions, and limitations transparently.
Support strategic workforce planning data, tools, and implementation efforts by identifying gaps, improvement opportunities, reusable materials, and training needs informed by partner feedback.
Collaborate with Strategic Initiatives Consultants and other HR partners to translate insights into practical actions and follow-through.

Job Requirements (Skills/Experience)

Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Business, HR, Economics, Statistics, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
5+ years of experience in people/workforce analytics, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) analytics, consulting, or related analytical roles.
Demonstrated ability to convert data into executive-ready insights and narratives, not just reporting results.
Proficiency with BI and analysis tools (e.g., Power BI/Tableau, Excel); experience working with HRIS/Oracle HCM data strongly preferred.
Working knowledge of workforce metrics (e.g., headcount/FTE, vacancies, attrition/movement, hiring pipeline indicators, workforce segments).
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; able to align HR, Finance, and business partners around a shared story and definitions.
Demonstrated ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments, create structure where none exists, challenge assumptions, and translate complex workforce issues into actionable business recommendations.

Preferred

Hands-on experience supporting workforce planning processes, tools, or planning cycles, including stakeholder engagement, adoption support, and translating insights into measurable value.
Familiarity with data governance practices (definitions, lineage, access controls, change control).
Experience with scenario-based thinking and workforce risk frameworks.

Additional Success Factors

Operates with a high degree of independence, ownership, and accountability.
Demonstrates intellectual curiosity and sound judgment when evaluating workforce trends, risks, and opportunities.
Influences decision-making through proactive communication, stakeholder engagement, and data-driven insights.
Continuously improves methods, processes, and tools to enhance workforce planning effectiveness.
Connects workforce insights to business strategy, performance, and enterprise outcomes.

new_jobs.description:
Customer Value Manager -
Hybrid role based in Lexington, MA

About Mimecast

The work people build is worth protecting, and it's harder to protect than it used to be. AI agents now move at machine speed with human-level access, and a small slip-up can become a very public one. We disrupt cybercriminal activity before that happens. We think fast, go big, and always demand more of ourselves. We work hard, deliver, and repeat. We grow with real determination and put success well within reach. We push each other to be better and expect to be pushed back, in a community built on respect, where everyone is counted. Work Protected.

Overview

Are you passionate about stopping bad things from happening to good organizations? At Mimecast, we do just that—and in Customer Value Management, we go further by making sure every customer realizes real, measurable value from what they’ve invested in.

We are looking for a driven, customer-centric Customer Value Manager to support a portfolio of named mid-market accounts. Based locally to Lexington, Massachusetts, you’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor and work within a three-person account pod alongside an Account Manager and a Renewals Manager. Your focus is clear: drive product adoption and utilization, own technical and value health, and turn the capabilities of our platform into outcomes customers care about. The through-line of the role is simple: adoption drives outcomes, and outcomes create value.

What You'll Do

Own platform adoption, activation, utilization, configuration health, and optimization across Mimecast’s product portfolio, including Email Threat Protection, Human Risk Management, Incydr (Code42), and DMARC Analyzer.
Advance customers’ Human Risk Management maturity by connecting behavior and attack-exposure data to Mimecast’s HRM framework and recommending targeted awareness-training outcomes.
Own technical and value health across your portfolio, tracking adoption depth, feature utilization, deployment completeness, customer satisfaction signals, and renewal risk.
Quantify and communicate proof of value through adoption metrics, threat-block summaries, HRM progression, and deployment health; prepare technical briefings and lead the value and technical narrative in Business Reviews, on-site EBRs, and executive meetings.
Build trusted customer relationships across technical and executive stakeholders, understand each customer’s environment and definition of success, translate complex security architecture into business value, and represent the voice of the customer to Product Management.
Partner with Account and Renewals Managers to identify churn risk at least 90 days before renewal, lead technical recovery plans, document competitive threats, and support gross retention, net revenue retention, and expansion outcomes.
Identify expansion signals—including unused modules, seat growth, HRM maturity readiness, and compliance gaps—and provide the Account Manager with the technical context and timing rationale needed to act.
Own transparency around critical technical escalations by representing customer context internally, coordinating with Support Engineering, and keeping customers and pod partners informed through resolution.
Support the Executive Sponsor Program by identifying suitable accounts, facilitating introductions, coordinating sponsor cadence calls, and briefing Mimecast sponsors before engagements.
Use customer data, health signals, AI-guided insights, and next-best-action recommendations to prioritize work and deliver evidence-based value conversations at scale.

What You'll Bring

Demonstrated success managing a portfolio of mid-market or enterprise accounts with the autonomy and judgment expected of an experienced customer-facing professional, ideally within a security-focused SaaS organization.
Working knowledge of email security architecture, including Secure Email Gateways, Microsoft 365 Defender, DMARC, DKIM, SPF, email routing, and hybrid mail flow.
Familiarity with identity and access management concepts such as Okta, Azure AD, SSO, and SAML, along with how email security integrates into SOC and SIEM/SOAR workflows.
Experience engaging technical administrators, CISOs, C-level executives, and legal and compliance teams, with the ability to translate complex security architecture into clear, value-focused business conversations without losing technical credibility.
Experience working alongside Account Managers or Account Executives in a named-account model, with clear technical and value ownership, strong strategic collaboration, and an understanding of commercial ownership.
Proficiency in customer health scoring, risk management, playbook execution, and Salesforce account activity and opportunity visibility.
A customer-centric and empathetic approach, technical curiosity, proactive ownership, resilience, analytical thinking, adaptability, and the ability to influence customers and colleagues without direct authority.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with credibility across both technical and executive audiences.
Ability to travel up to 25%.
Direct experience with Mimecast, Abnormal, Proofpoint, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, or comparable email security or Human Risk Management platforms is preferred.
Security or vendor certifications—such as CompTIA Security+, CISSP Associate or full certification, CEH, or credentials aligned with email or cloud security—are preferred.
Familiarity with FINRA, HIPAA, FCA, GDPR, ISO 27001, and SOC 2, plus the ability to interpret API logs, review connector health, and diagnose integration issues without first-level escalation, is preferred.

The position may also be eligible for incentive plans and additional benefits, in accordance with company policy and local regulations. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location with individual compensation also dependent on factors such as qualifications, experience, and skills. Final offers will reflect these considerations and may vary accordingly.

The Trade Compliance Analyst - Export Classification supports international shipping and trade compliance operations by reviewing and validating U.S. export-control classifications for products.

This role focuses on applying export classification regulations through use of the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and Commerce Control List (CCL) to determine whether products are classified under an Export Control Classification Number (ECCN), including EAR99. The analyst will research product information, apply established classification guidance, document conclusions, and escalate items that require additional review.

This is an opportunity for someone with experience in U.S. export controls who wants to build specialized expertise in product classification within a global trade, logistics, or supply chain environment.

Responsibilities

Review and validate export-control classifications for products.
Research the EAR and CCL to determine appropriate ECCN classifications and EAR99 treatment.
Evaluate product descriptions, technical specifications, manufacturer information, images, and related documentation to support classification decisions.
Identify items that may fall within a controlled ECCN and distinguish them from items classified as EAR99.
Document classification decisions, supporting rationale, and relevant research in accordance with established procedures.
Escalate complex, ambiguous, or technically sensitive classifications when additional expertise is required.
Support regular auditing activities and ensure alignment with internal policies, processes, and procedures.
Collaborate with Compliance, Operations, and cross-functional teams to resolve classification questions and support export-control compliance.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Foundational knowledge of U.S. export controls, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and/or International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR).
Working knowledge of the Commerce Control List (CCL) and ECCN framework.
Understanding of EAR99 classifications and export-control requirements.
Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail and ability to make well-supported decisions based on available information.
Strong written communication and documentation skills.
Ability to manage recurring workloads while maintaining accuracy and consistency.

Preferred Qualifications

1-3 years of experience in trade compliance, export controls, product classification, customs compliance, logistics, supply chain, international trade, or a related field.
Direct experience with ECCN classification, CCL research, or EAR99 determinations.
Familiarity with technical product specifications and manufacturer documentation.
Understanding of HS/HTS classification and the distinction between tariff classification and export-control classification.
Experience in logistics, freight forwarding, customs brokerage, supply chain operations, international trade, or related environments.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means making accurate, timely, and well-supported export classification decisions; consistently applying the EAR and CCL; maintaining clear documentation; recognizing when escalation is needed; and contributing to a strong, scalable export-compliance program.

Maintain strong business relationships and regular, strategic touchpoints with the assigned book of business
Guide customers through onboarding and adoption with a consultative lens, often including paid services and workflow design
Own premium onboarding cases by assisting customers in the template and workflow set up, leading training sessions and driving value within their first 90 days
Drive product adoption and usage through proactive engagement and tailored Success Plans, focusing on long-term customer outcomes
Identify and mitigate risk by uncovering usage blockers and developing customer-centric solutions to reduce churn and contraction
Analyze account metrics (e.g., license usage, document activity, engagement trends) to create success benchmarks and guide business reviews
Own customer escalations when they arise—working cross-functionally to drive swift resolution—while proactively addressing early signals to prevent issues from escalating
Partner closely with Account Managers to align on renewal strategy, inform upsell paths, and support expansion opportunities
Collaborate with Solutions Engineers and Technical Account Managers to address complex workflow requirements and technical use cases
Proactively engage with the Product and Support teams to advocate for customer feedback and ensure it’s routed through the right channels
Monitor tools to surface actionable insights and provide targeted outreach to accounts needing additional support
Serve as a thought partner to both customers and teammates—sharing insights, elevating questions, and championing collaboration across teams

There is an opportunity to make a measurable impact by helping clients unlock productivity gains, streamline processes, and achieve their business goals. As part of the Customer Success team, the individual will be at the forefront of client satisfaction, directly contributing to the organization's continued growth and success. If you thrive in an ever-evolving environment and love the challenge of making customers successful, this is the role for you!

Executive Presence & Communication:

Customer-Centric & Relationship-Driven:

Organized & Detail-Oriented:
Highly organized and excels at managing competing priorities. Delivers high-quality service with precision, even in fast-paced, dynamic environments.

Strategic Thinker & Problem Solver:
Thrives on solving complex challenges. Thinks big-picture, anticipates customer needs, and proactively identifies opportunities to deliver value. Knows how to align the platform’s capabilities with the customer’s business goals.

Growth-Oriented & Accountable:
Self-motivated, coachable, and always looking for ways to grow. Takes full ownership of work and consistently follows through on commitments.

Agile & Collaborative:
Adapts quickly to change and loves working cross-functionally to ensure the best outcomes for customers. Brings energy to the team and fosters a collaborative, supportive environment where others can succeed.

AI:
